meta.name: full-output-enforcement
meta.description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制生成完整代码，禁止占位符截断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到LLM输出被截断或出现占位符的问题
copy.tagline_en: Force complete code generation, ban placeholder truncation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face LLM output truncation or placeholder issues

howto.what: Claude 的输出不再被截断:不写 ... 、TODO 等占位符,不用骨架代替完整实现。你要几个文件、几个函数就交付几个,写完为止。接近长度上限时会在一个完整断点停下并提示你发送 continue。
howto.when: 当你要求完整、无删减的产出时接管,例如「给我完整文件」、「5 个组件全要」。原文写明适用于任何需要穷尽、不删减输出的任务。

say.text: 把这个文件的完整代码写出来,不要省略任何部分
say.note: 不会出现 ... 或 TODO 占位符

say.text: 这个模块有 5 个函数,请全部实现
say.note: 先锁定数量,再逐个写完整
从上次中断处接着写,不重复已有内容

howto.what_en: Claude stops truncating output: no ... or TODO placeholders, no skeletons instead of real implementations. Ask for five components and you get five, fully written. Near the token limit it pauses at a clean breakpoint and tells you to send "continue".
howto.when_en: Takes over when you need exhaustive, unabridged output, e.g. "give me the full file" or "all 5 components". The original states it applies to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.

say_en.text: Write out the full code for this file, don't omit any part
say_en.note: No ... or TODO placeholders will appear

say_en.text: This module has 5 functions, implement all of them
say_en.note: Count is locked first, then each is written out
Resumes exactly where it stopped, no repetition
